runtime.sql: select current_version() as snowflake_version, current_region() as region, current_role() as role, current_database() as database_name, current_warehouse() as warehouse

load_audit.sql: select table_name, file_sha256, row_count from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.LOAD_AUDIT order by table_name, file_sha256

raw_count_orders.sql: select count(*) as source_rows from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.ORDERS

raw_count_order_items.sql: select count(*) as source_rows from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.ORDER_ITEMS

raw_count_customers.sql: select count(*) as source_rows from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.CUSTOMERS

raw_count_products.sql: select count(*) as source_rows from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.PRODUCTS

raw_count_payments.sql: select count(*) as source_rows from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.PAYMENTS

raw_count_reviews.sql: select count(*) as source_rows from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.REVIEWS

raw_count_category_translation.sql: select count(*) as source_rows from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.CATEGORY_TRANSLATION

catalogue_quality.sql: select count(case when category_name='__unknown__' then 1 end) as missing_category_products, count(distinct case when not has_translation and category_name<>'__unknown__' then category_name end) as untranslated_categories from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.DEV_MARTS.DIM_PRODUCT

zero_payments.sql: select payment_type, count(*) as payment_records from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.DEV_STAGING.STG_PAYMENTS where payment_value=0 group by payment_type order by payment_type

review_grain.sql: select count(*) as review_order_pairs, count(distinct review_id) as distinct_review_ids, count(distinct order_id) as distinct_reviewed_orders from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.RAW.REVIEWS

reference_worklist_count.sql:
select count(*) as reference_candidates from (-- Reference integration query, NOT a live feed or a historical eligibility replay.
-- Replace the timestamp with a bound scheduler parameter and refresh the source first.
-- Current status / event freshness / cancellation / prior-action checks must be atomic
-- in the operational system immediately before notifying a seller.
with run_context as (
    select to_timestamp_ntz('2018-08-31 00:00:00') as as_of_at
)
select r.order_id, r.seller_id, r.shipping_deadline_at, r.estimated_delivery_date,
       'confirm carrier pickup; escalate only if unresolved' as proposed_action
from ELIO_ASSESSMENT.DEV_MARTS.MART_DELIVERY_RISK r
cross join run_context c
where r.has_valid_dispatch_context
  and r.order_status in ('approved', 'invoiced', 'processing')
  and r.approved_at <= c.as_of_at
  and r.carrier_received_at is null and r.delivered_at is null
  and r.trigger_at <= c.as_of_at
  and r.trigger_at > dateadd(day, -2, c.as_of_at) -- do not replay stale backlog
  and dateadd(day, 2, cast(c.as_of_at as date)) <= r.estimated_delivery_date
order by r.estimated_delivery_date, r.order_id
)
